body: The NH3 stress threshold (0.02 mg/L) and response scale (2.0) in `step_hourly_shrimp_stress()` (shrimp.rs:123-124) are hardcoded: `if nh3_mg_l > 0.02 { state.animal.hourly_nh3_stress_accum += (nh3_mg_l - 0.02) * 2.0 / 24.0; }`. These feed into the stress_total that drives mortality, including molt-stress-linked mortality. Extract them as named parameters.
